description: This file contains functions for managing firmware upgrades and boot partition selection for a Linksys device running OpenWrt. It includes logic to determine the current target firmware, to set the environment for upgrade, and to copy configuration backups.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines which firmware partition (kernel1/kernel2) should be booted based on current boot environment or UBI info.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade, identifying target partition and handling different magic numbers for image types.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_linksys
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to the system backup location.
